Subject: Hartford gate kiosks: incident summary (Aug 3)

Hi Mateo,

Summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident from Aug 3:
- The gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline that morning. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Dispatch scheduling kept working; this affected gate check-in only.
- Kiosk 1 came back first, and trailer 8836 was checked in and visible to dispatch. Both lanes were confirmed working as of Aug 3, 11:07.
- Your status-page access is tracked separately under ticket INC-4821. We're still working on it. Your admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals.

Thanks,
Gideon
